segments.text: she wakes up on the floor of a wrecked yacht, and her fiancé is gone.
A hurricane flipped the boat. She was out cold for {27|twenty-seven} hours. His safety line is still tied on. Nobody is on the end of it.
The engine is dead. So she pumps out the cabin, and hangs one small sail on a broken pole.
Then a plane flies right over her, low. It doesn't see her. Neither do two ships.
So she aims for Hawaii, {1,500|fifteen hundred} miles away, with a sextant, and a watch she finds in the bilge.
On day {41|forty-one}, a ship finds her just outside the harbour at Hilo, Hawaii. She steered that wreck there herself.
Richard Sharp was lost in the storm. She went back to sea. I was wrong. Case closed. It all began when
